missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Nominative subject. 'Пуля' stays in the nominative as the subject of 'пролетела', which agrees in feminine gender. 'Мимо окна' is a genitive phrase showing the path.
Strategic focus: Accusative object. 'Пулю' is the accusative direct object of 'зарядил'. 'Одну' agrees in the feminine accusative, counting a single round.
Strategic focus: Genitive after verb. 'Пули' is the genitive required by 'испугался', the thing feared. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine genitive.
Strategic focus: Genitive of comparison. 'Пули' is the genitive after the comparative 'быстрее', naming the standard of comparison. A vivid idiomatic pattern.
Strategic focus: Nominative subject with location. 'Пуля' is the nominative subject of 'лежала', which agrees in feminine gender. 'На столе' gives the prepositional location.
Strategic focus: Prepositional case. 'В пуле' uses the prepositional form 'пуле' after 'в' to locate the flaw. 'Этой' agrees in the feminine prepositional case.
Strategic focus: Prepositional topic. 'О пуле' uses the prepositional form after 'о' to mark the topic of the account. 'Подробно' adds the manner of telling.
Strategic focus: Counted accusative. After 'две' the noun takes the genitive singular form 'пули'. The numeral two governs this special counting form for feminine nouns.
Strategic focus: Nominative plural subject. 'Пули' is the nominative plural subject of 'летели'. 'Над головами' is an instrumental phrase showing where they flew.
Strategic focus: Instrumental of means. 'Пулей' is the instrumental, the means of the wounding in this impersonal construction. 'Шальной' agrees in the feminine instrumental.
